description: Read a text file with line numbers; paginate large files with offset and limit. Use instead of cat/head/tail in terminal. Output: 'LINE_NUM|CONTENT'. Suggests similar filenames if not found. Reads over ~100K characters are truncated on a line boundary and return a next_offset; continue from it with offset. A line longer than ~2K chars is clamped at '... [truncated]' and listed in clamped_lines with a hint naming the command that reads its remainder (offset cannot reach it). Documents auto-extract to text: .ipynb, Office (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx and legacy .doc/.ppt/.xls), PDF (text layer), OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, SQLite (.db/.sqlite: schema, row counts, first rows). Cannot read images/binary; use vision_analyze for images.
name: read_file

limit.description: Max lines to read (max 2000), also capped at a ~100K-character budget with a next_offset continuation.
